newsitem.title: USA: Morton's to sell Atlanta restaurants.
newsitem.headline: Morton's to sell Atlanta restaurants.

text.p: Morton's Restaurant Group Inc said Friday it has definitively agreed to sell a majority interest in its Atlanta-based Mick's and Peasant restaurants for $6.8 million.
The company said it will take a non-recurring, pre-tax charge in the range of $9 to $12 million and also recognize income tax benefits in the fourth quarter for the sale.
The purchase price consists of $4.3 million in cash and $2.5 million in two unsecured promissory notes, Morton's said.

Morton's said MRI Acquisition Corp will acquire 80.1 percent interest in Mick's Restaurants Inc, and PRI Acquisition Corp will take an 80.1 percent interest in Peasant Restaurants Inc. Morton's will retain 19.9 percent interest.
The deal should close on or before February 28.
"This sale is in keeping with our previously announced decision to focus our full resources on our two core fine-dining concepts," Morton's of Chicago and Bertolini's, the company said in a release.
